verdict.rationale: Base44 ships a managed, built-in backend: the builder's Data page shows every table and its records, the SDK provides entity CRUD wired to the app, and the CLI syncs data models. A community user independently confirms the database is included within the platform rather than configured externally. Missing for 10: explicit first-party docs describing automatic database/schema provisioning when the AI builds an app, and documentation of in-builder schema editing or migrations.
